records: Coinbase's 3.7% Circle ownership is the post-IPO percentage in Circle's 2025 S-1, not a verified current 2026 percentage. Coinbase's Q3 2026 10-Q confirms the arrangement was renewed on the same terms but does not provide an updated share count. The $22B average USDC held in Coinbase products and $8.616B USDC AOP at September 30, 2026 use different definitions/periods and are not reconciled. Circle's latest available financial filing in this run is Q2 2026; Q3 results were not yet available. Circle's reserve-yield sensitivity is a conditional scenario holding circulation and reserve allocation constant, not a forecast. Neither Coinbase's equity stake nor Circle's distribution payments establish XRP purchases, collateral deposits or price impact.
